environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 application on AWS Lambda. A CloudFront distribution is configured as the sole entry point with Origin Access Control (OAC) using sigv4 signing to the Lambda function URL. The Lambda function URL AuthType is set to AWS_IAM, and the resource-based policy on the Lambda function restricts invoke permission exclusively to the CloudFront service principal (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) with a condition key matching the specific distribution ARN (aws:SourceArn). CloudFront is configured with a custom cache policy that requires signed URLs (TrustedKeyGroups with a single RSA-2048 key group). Unsigned requests receive a 403 from CloudFront before reaching origin. The CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior with viewer-request association to a CloudFront Function that validates the query string length is ≤ 256 characters and rejects requests exceeding this with a 413 response. The signed URL policy restricts the query string to the exact resource path and cannot include arbitrary q= parameters beyond what was signed at issuance time.
